dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY includes (.INC), LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA pattern typical of ORCA subsystem programs.
evidence: COPY CPSYSKANRI.INC / CPSRYACT.INC / MCPDATA.INC / ORCA-SPA / COMMON-SPA
No EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/shinryo-koui) system — specifically a subprogram handling out-of-benefit-coverage point calculation for Fukuoka Prefecture local public expense support, within the JMA ORCA standard receipt software.
purpose.summary: Subprogram ORCSSYU40 calculates insurance-excluded (kyufugai) medical procedure points for initial consultation fees, home-visit fees, and related add-on items. It is called from both the medical-act entry screen and the payment (syunou) screen, and returns aggregated point totals in the linkage area.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA (ORCA subsystem pattern)
14 COPY statements for shared record layouts (.INC files)
OCCURS table with INDEXED BY and SEARCH (linear table lookup for procedure codes)
REDEFINES on table area for structured access
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
EXIT PROGRAM at end of main section
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, appearing garbled. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (full file is 42927 bytes / 1056 lines). The ORCA project is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt system; this is a regional (Fukuoka Prefecture) adaptation subprogram.
